mine: the far side of the wilderness
note: Hebrew 'ahar hammidbar means behind/beyond (i.e. west of) the wilderness; "backside" now reads oddly and the area is steppe pasture rather than desert.

mine: I (Yahweh) have surely taken note of you (Israel)
note: paqad paqadti means to attend to or take action on someone's behalf; modern "visited" suggests a social call.

kjv: every woman shall borrow of her neighbour
mine: Each woman shall ask of her neighbor
note: sha'al means to ask or request; nothing implies a loan to be returned, and the outcome is that Israel "plunders" (natsal) Egypt.

kjv: jewels of silver, and jewels of gold
mine: articles of silver and articles of gold
note: kele kesef = vessels/objects of silver (any manufactured item), not specifically gems or jewellery as "jewels" now implies.
